text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor c-o-p-i-e-d the b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e u-s-i-n-g the e-x-p-o-r-t f-u-n-c-t-i-o-n, which l-e-f-t a d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e l-o-g as the t-r-a-c-e, and the e-x-p-o-r-t a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
2) the actor e-n-r-o-l-l-e-d the f-a-l-s-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y i-n-t-o the a-c-c-e-s-s s-y-s-t-e-m u-s-i-n-g the a-d-m-i-n c-o-n-s-o-l-e, which l-e-f-t a n-e-w u-s-e-r r-e-c-o-r-d as the t-r-a-c-e, and the m-u-l-t-i-f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
3) the actor c-l-o-n-e-d the a-c-c-e-s-s c-a-r-d k-e-y-s w-i-t-h the r-f-i-d r-e-a-d-e-r, which l-e-f-t a s-c-a-n a-u-d-i-t e-n-t-r-y as the t-r-a-c-e, and the h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
4) the actor a-l-t-e-r-e-d the s-u-b-j-e-c-t f-i-e-l-d-s i-n the a-c-c-e-s-s l-o-g-s u-s-i-n-g the d-b-s h-o-s-t, which l-e-f-t a c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t h-a-s-h as the t-r-a-c-e, and the t-a-m-p-e-r-d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
5) the actor d-e-l-e-t-e-d the s-e-s-s-i-o-n f-i-l-e-s f-r-o-m the c-a-c-h-e d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y, which l-e-f-t a d-i-s-k i-m-a-g-e as the t-r-a-c-e, and the r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n p-o-l-i-c-y was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
